headline: Executive order widens who can receive the Defense Meritorious Service Medal, a U.S. military award.
what_it_does: This order changes the rules for the Defense Meritorious Service Medal, an award given for outstanding service in defense-related jobs. Based on its title, it makes more people eligible to receive the medal than before. No summary was provided, so the exact new groups and rules are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People serving in or alongside the U.S. military in defense-related roles
who_it_affects.how: Some people who could not get this medal before may now be eligible for it.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 18, 2014; the effective date is not stated in the provided material.
